taxonomic_note: Accepted by Kew/POWO and ITIS; native across temperate North America including Texas.
look_here_first: A wetland grass with very rough, cutting leaf margins and an open panicle whose flattened one-flowered spikelets resemble tiny rice grains.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays — project Hays-local source pool and San Marcos River Joey frame. Bell — Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas documents Leersia oryzoides in Bell County. A third exact target-zone native county still needs authoritative documentation.
project_inclusion.learner_role: retain Joey/local ID record; do not count as native PASS yet

best_field_traits: rough/scabrous leaf margins capable of cutting skin
open panicle that may be partly enclosed by the upper sheath
morphology_keys.joey_field_note: Joey's San Marcos frame provides local water-edge habit; structural confirmation should focus on rough leaves and rice-like spikelets.
